must_retain: every POST including rejected/failed/retried, metadata plus body
every response metadata plus raw SSE/error body
every hook trace started/stdin/stdout/stderr/finished, including failures/incomplete traces
complete permission output/capture, signatures and actual window writes
target baseline/final bytes and actual identity receipts
post_stop_validation: filesystem inventory and archive bytes only; never SQLite; any new/changed raw record blocks root deletion
byte_readback_policy: no PASS field may be emitted before actual member type/target/content-byte equality is read back
missing_or_new_record_policy: archive/cleanup BLOCKED, retain root and diagnostics; do not synthesize from summary
